analysis.jobDescription: We are looking for a Junior Frontend Developer with strong skills in React, TypeScript and CSS. Experience with REST APIs, Git and responsive design is required. Knowledge of testing (Jest) and accessibility is a plus.

tips.tip: Clear section headings that ATS can parse
Add 'REST API' and 'Jest' keywords from the job description

tips.explanation: Bullet points are short and start with action verbs such as 'Built' and 'Designed'.
The summary uses 'I am'. Resumes read better in implied first person, e.g. 'Frontend developer with…'.
Past roles mix present and past tense. Use past tense for finished work.
The AI Resume Analyzer project directly shows React and API experience.
Add numbers, e.g. 'reduced page load time by 30%' or 'used by 200 students'.
The job lists Jest as a plus; add any unit tests you have written.
One page is ideal for a junior candidate.
Education, Skills, Projects, Experience is a good order for a student.
Some ATS cannot read tables. Use a simple comma-separated list.
React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Git match the job requirements.
The job mentions accessibility; list any ARIA or WCAG experience.
Split into Languages, Frameworks and Tools so recruiters scan faster.
